hooks.name: Wording check on save
hooks.description: Gloam must never say a route is safe. Whenever app source changes, run the banned-word and wording tests so a slip is caught in seconds, not at the next checkpoint.

action.command: cd app && npx vitest --run tests/wording.test.ts tests/ownWording.test.ts tests/bannedWords.property.test.ts
